title: Pair-based OXR triple distribution
statement: Let $S$ be the set of signs. The pair-based OXR triple distribution on triples of signs is the law obtained by sampling a pair uniformly from $S\times S$ and applying the OXR pair-to-triple map.
caveat: The definition of the OXR pair-to-triple map and the meaning of the sign type are not included in the supplied definitions.
